text:
maria.g: Quick proposal — add two deploy-bot improvements to reduce manual friction during change windows: a --fast-rollback flag (for emergency quick revert) and a release-template subcommand that auto-populates release notes from merged PRs.

liam.k: Sounds good. Fast rollback should require: canary status check OR a manual override, and a single confirmation prompt. Also add a shorthand: pin --version <semver>.

sophia.r: Example usage I'd like: /deploy canary --service inference-api --pin v2.1.3 --change-window '2026-03-25 22:00-23:00' --fast-rollback

sophia.r: Quick draft for templates and rollback script:```
# release-template config (YAML)
release_template: 
  sections:
    - breaking
    - features
    - fixes
source: github:org/repo
pr_query: 'merged:>={last_release_date}'

# tiny rollback helper (bash)
#!/bin/bash
# usage: fast-rollback <service> <target-tag>
SERVICE=$1
TAG=$2
# safety: require explicit CONFIRM=YES env var or interactive confirmation
if [[ "$CONFIRM" != "YES" ]]; then
  read -p "Confirm fast rollback $SERVICE -> $TAG? Type YES: " c
  [[ "$c" == "YES" ]] || exit 1
fi
# call deploy-bot API
curl -X POST "https://deploy.internal/api/rollback" -d '{"service":"'$SERVICE'","tag":"'$TAG'","mode":"fast"}'
```

deploy-bot: noted: feature-proposal logged (PR #4120). Tagged as infra/deploy and rfc-needed.

alex.t: +1 on templating. Make release-template include: merged PR list, author, short changelog line (first line of PR), and an auto-label heuristic (chore/docs/feature/fix) so product can review quickly.

jen.p: Can we also add rate-limiting and a cooldown window for fast-rollback? We don't want cascading rollbacks across clusters. Also include audit logging (who triggered rollback + commit hash).

maria.g: Yep — plan: open PR that adds flags to the bot, introduces a release-template job that runs against GitHub, includes an opt-in feature flag for 2 weeks, and a cooldown/rate-limit config (default 10 min per service). I'll include unit tests + e2e sim for rollback.

liam.k: :thumbsup: I can take the canary gating change — will wire health-check pass thresholds into the bot guard.

jen.p: Nice. If PR lands this week we can dogfood on staging during next change window.

maria.g: I'll post the PR link when it's up and add a lightweight checklist for release engineers (how to opt-in/out, how to run fast-rollback safely). Thanks everyone! :rocket:
